notes: Pay and dates are from the 2025 post, so check the 2027 posting. Michigan requires a work permit for workers under 18. From Oct 2, 2026 permits are issued through the state Youth Employment Permit Portal. Aquatic center is at 6400 Abbot Road.
name: East Lansing Family Aquatic Center summer jobs
org: City of East Lansing, Family Aquatic Center
what_you_do: Work as a lifeguard, slide worker or customer helper at the city pool. You need no experience. The city trains you in May in Red Cross lifeguarding, CPR, first aid and AED.
who_can_apply: Age 16 or older. You can work at least 25 hours a week, with some weekends and holidays.
pay_detail: 2025 pay: lifeguards $14.50 an hour, slide operators and customer service $13 an hour.
deadline_text: Last posting was March 11, 2025 for summer 2025. No deadline was listed. The jobs page showed no seasonal openings in October 2026, so expect spring hiring.
how_to_apply: Apply through the City of East Lansing jobs page. You can sign up for job alerts there.
